newsitem.title: USA: CBO says Clinton budget results in deficit in 2002.
newsitem.headline: CBO says Clinton budget results in deficit in 2002.

text.p: The Congressional Budget Office on Monday said President Clinton's budget would result in a $69 billion deficit in 2002.
The finding was a bigger deficit than the $50 billion CBO had earlier estimated of the president's budget.

House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich, a Republican from Ohio, released the CBO report and asked President Clinton to submit another budget. "In light of these facts, the president should submit a new budget, one that is in balance in 2002," he said.
